# CANDIDATE: BOS_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a bullish break of structure (price makes a new higher high after a prior higher low), a pullback to the 21-EMA with an intact bullish 8/21/34 EMA ribbon provides a low-risk long entry. This setup captures continuation momentum in trending markets while defining risk via the prior swing low that preceded the BOS.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When market structure prints a BOS (price makes a new higher high after a prior higher low), and on the subsequent bar(s) price retests to within 0.1×ATR of the 21-EMA while the 8/21/34 EMA ribbon remains bullish (8 > 21 > 34), enter long at the close of the retest bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the swing low (the prior higher low) that preceded the BOS. TP1 at 2R (double the risk from entry to stop). Runner trail: 20% off the high-water mark after TP1 fills.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when price > 50-EMA, VIX < 20, and time between 10:30-15:00 ET to avoid choppy open/close and focus on trending midday sessions.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and min 3 contracts.
2. **Sample bias:** Zero historical backtest conducted; proposal based solely on price action theory. High overfit risk without Stage-1 validation on 16-month SPY 5m data.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic OPRA simulation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw in ranging market (multiple failed BOS retests); max drawdown: consecutive losses during regime shift (e.g., trend to chop); blow-up scenario: volatility expansion invalidating ribbon (e.g., VIX spike >30 causing EMA compression and false signals).
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (cannot estimate top-5 days contribution without historical simulation).
